summary:
EarthTrend Detective is an interactive Earth science research platform developed by Team Tech_Innovators to help people explore environmental changes using real NASA observations.

The platform integrates NASA MERRA-2, GPM IMERG, and GLDAS datasets to investigate temperature, precipitation, and soil moisture trends. Users can explore geographic regions, inspect time-series observations, compare environmental patterns, and evaluate trends using transparent statistical methods.

Built with React, FastAPI, Python, and geospatial analysis tools, EarthTrend Detective combines interactive geographic selection, scientific visualizations, evidence-based interpretations, and downloadable research reports. Its research workflow preserves source metadata, units, geographic coverage, and methodological limitations to help prevent misleading conclusions.

By transforming complex NASA Earth observation data into an accessible investigation experience, EarthTrend Detective supports environmental awareness, scientific literacy, and more informed research. The platform demonstrates how open Earth science data can make environmental change easier to explore, understand, and communicate.
details:
EarthTrend Detective — Investigating Environmental Change with NASA Data

The Problem

NASA provides an extraordinary collection of Earth science observations, but interpreting raw environmental datasets can be challenging for students, researchers, and the general public. Scientific data often require specialized knowledge of geospatial processing, statistical methods, geographic coverage, and measurement units.

Without accessible tools and clear methodological explanations, it is difficult to investigate environmental change and distinguish meaningful patterns from misleading conclusions.

Our Solution

EarthTrend Detective is an interactive, web-based environmental research platform developed by Team Tech_Innovators for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

Our project helps users explore NASA Earth science observations, investigate environmental trends, visualize geographic information, and interpret research findings through a transparent scientific workflow.

It combines environmental data processing, interactive geographic exploration, statistical analysis, evidence-based interpretations, and reproducible research documentation in one application.

How EarthTrend Detective Works

1. NASA Earth Science Data

Our platform integrates three NASA scientific products:

  • MERRA-2: Atmospheric reanalysis data used to investigate near-surface air temperature.
  • GPM IMERG V07: Monthly precipitation estimates used to examine rainfall patterns.
  • GLDAS Noah V2.1: Land-surface model data used to investigate surface soil moisture.

We processed 300 monthly files each for GPM IMERG and GLDAS, covering January 2000 through December 2024, for a Bangladesh study area. The platform also includes a curated MERRA-2 temperature time series.

2. Interactive Geographic Exploration

EarthTrend Detective provides an interactive world map built using Natural Earth geographic boundaries.

Users can select countries, define rectangular study regions, and draw bounded polygons. Geographic validation safeguards help prevent unsupported analysis outside the available scientific data coverage.

3. Environmental Trend Analysis

The Python backend validates observation files, geographic coordinates, scientific variables, and measurement units before analysis.

The application applies statistical techniques including linear regression, Sen's slope estimation, and the Mann–Kendall trend test to investigate long-term environmental patterns.

4. Scientific Visualization

Environmental observations and research findings are presented through time-series charts, statistical summaries, trend indicators, and geographic investigation tools.

Users can investigate changing environmental conditions while reviewing the underlying data coverage and analysis methodology.

5. Research Library and Reporting

The application supports validated research records, scientific provenance information, research history, and downloadable PDF reports.

These features help preserve reproducibility and allow users to examine the evidence supporting environmental interpretations.

Technologies Used

Frontend: React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Vite.

Backend: Python and FastAPI.

Scientific Computing: NumPy, SciPy, xarray, netCDF4, and Shapely.

Research Storage: SQLite.

Geographic Data: Natural Earth.

NASA Resources: MERRA-2, GPM IMERG, GLDAS, and NASA Earth science services.

Hosting: Vercel for the frontend and Render for the backend.

Innovation

EarthTrend Detective goes beyond basic environmental charts by connecting geographic investigation, genuine scientific observations, transparent statistical methods, and reproducible research.

Its core innovation is making complex environmental research more accessible while retaining safeguards against unsupported geographic coverage, incorrect scientific units, fabricated observations, and misleading statistical interpretations.

The platform distinguishes between available observations, published research records, and datasets that require additional configuration.

Intended Impact

EarthTrend Detective aims to support environmental education, scientific literacy, exploratory research, and evidence-based communication.

Students, researchers, and interested members of the public can use the platform to investigate environmental patterns and develop a better understanding of changes affecting our planet.

By transforming complex NASA observations into an accessible research experience, our project demonstrates how open Earth science data can support curiosity, understanding, and more informed environmental discussions.

Our Mission: Explore Earth. Investigate environmental change. Follow the evidence.
